sections.kicker: Prepared for Rhapsody in Gold by Atla · November 2026
sections.lead: We looked at your site and your Instagram the way a new customer would. Here is what stood out, in order of weight.
sections.thesis: Rhapsody in Gold has a rare idea: Chinese characters in gold. Instagram says only fine jewellery.
sections.keep: Your line, "Poems stitched together in gold". It is the brand in five words.

sections.label: Front door
title: Three things people
meet first.
Three things

pins.quote: Contemporary Chinese character jewellery in 18k gold
pins.what: Your real difference is on the site.
pins.why: Chinese character jewellery is a reason no other fine jeweller can claim.
pins.how: Make this the first thing every channel says.
pins.label: Your site
pins.cost: Instagram visitors compare you with every bespoke jeweller.

pins.quote: Fine Jewellery that tells your story.
pins.what: The bio says what thousands of jewellers say.
pins.why: Fine and bespoke tell a visitor nothing about the characters.
pins.how: Bring the character idea into the bio.
pins.label: Your bio
pins.cost: The followers you have never learn what makes you rare.

pins.what: The strongest phrase sits in small print.
pins.why: A line this good can carry the whole brand.
pins.how: Promote it to the headline on the site and bio.
pins.label: Your line

sections.intro: You asked for a look at Rhapsody in Gold. I spent some time on your site and your Instagram. Three things stood out.

sections.body: It is 20 minutes with me. We go through this page together, on Rhapsody in Gold's own screens, and you leave knowing what to change first.
sections.note: A few short questions first, then you pick a time. You can also just reply to the email.
